description:
Job Title: Cognos Developer 
 Skills Required and Job Description: 

 Interview mode: Face 2 face
 No h1B
 Main Skill Set being sought: 

 Advanced Cognos Report Development on all suites with Report Studio being the main
 COGNOS Dynamic cubes
 Powerplay Transformer (Powercubes)
 SSAS Development – mid level to expert
 SQL
 ETL a plus
 Dimensional Modelling experience a plus
 The developer will manage the design and development of management reports on company intranet. This position will also guarantee the performance integrity and quality of reports, ensure report performance and resolve problems, maintain database dictionaries and report guides, and coordinates with other IT departments to ensure implementation and monitoring of reports.
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 

 Analyzes, designs and develops board room quality Cognos models, reports, and dashboards.
 Tests and troubleshoots issues as they arise.
 Works closely with data modelers to build and support the IBM Cognos metadata models.
 Develops and implements interactive dashboards to help drive business decisions.
 Understands business requirements and translates them into high quality Cognos report deliverables.
 Monitors and responds to different tickets/defects.
 Expert in SQL including performance tuning.
 Troubleshoots/resolves help desk tickets in accordance with all SLA established timeframes.
 Manages/handles deployments into UAT and production environments.
 FUNCTIONAL JOB COMPETENCIES 

 Integrity and Trust: Is widely trusted; is seen as a direct, truthful individual; can present the unvarnished truth in an appropriate and helpful manner; keeps confidences; admits mistakes; doesn’t misrepresent him/herself for personal gain.
 Written Communications: Is able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles; can get messages across that have the desired effect.
 Business Acumen: Knows how businesses work; knowledgeable in current and possible future policies, practices, trends, and information affecting his/her business and organization; knows the competition; is aware of how strategies and tactics work in the marketplace.
 Excellent spoken and communication skills.
 Excellent planning and task-tracking skills.
 Excellent analysis and assessment of business needs and cross-system impacts.
 Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Project and Visio.
 Capable in SQL data analysis and programming interpretation.
 Excellent team-play skills, able to work in fast-paced environment on multiple projects/jobs concurrently.
 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months Contract 
 
 INTERVIEW: Face 2 face
